Charms made around you

Wearfiax is a keychain-making experience where you create your own beaded charm. Join the TikTok Live, choose your preferred theme, pendant or charm and bead colors, and we put together a design that matches your personality.

Made for collectors. If you are 12 to your 30s and love cute little things, especially miniatures, beaded charms and character items like Chiikawa, Mofusand, Sanrio, Miffy and Monchhichi, this is your shop.

How ordering works

Four steps from idea to a charm on your bag.

  1. 1

    Join the live

    Watch Wearfiax on TikTok Live and build your charm with us. Pick a theme, a pendant or charm, and your bead colors.

  2. 2

    Send your order

    Message the Wearfiax page, or send a message to Camie fielax on Facebook.

  3. 3

    Pay with GCash

    GCash is the payment method we accept.

  4. 4

    Get it delivered

    Choose J&T or Lalamove. Rates are listed under Shipping and payment.
